lines.t: Excuse me. Does this model work with my phone? I’m looking for wireless headphones, but I’m not good at choosing electronics.
Yes, it does. Are you happy with your current pair, or are you looking for something different?
Not really. I bought them last week, and they worked at first. Yesterday, the sound stopped on one side.
I see. Are you interested in a replacement, or do you want a refund? We can check the receipt first.
A replacement, please. Are you sure this model works with older phones? Mine isn’t very new.
Yes. I’m testing it with your phone now. The connection is working, and you can try the sound before you decide.
Great. I usually listen to podcasts while I wait for the bus, so clear sound matters more to me than extra features.
To connect them next time, press this button, then choose their name on your phone. Does that make sense?
Yes, it does. I’m going to pay by card. Do I need to pay for the case as well?
No, the case comes with the headphones. Keep your receipt, and talk to us if there’s a problem.
